Hi Sofia,

Quick question from our AP side as we prepare to ingest Redwood invoices for Q4: can you confirm which delivery channel you prefer for Sunbridge invoices? Our team prefers invoices uploaded to a vendor portal with structured fields (PO, tax ID) — we can onboard to Redwood Portal if you support it.

Date: Wed, 10 Oct 2028 01:04:00 -0700

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear note and the PO.

Short answer: we can make the Redwood Portal the primary delivery method and simultaneously enable an email fallback while you finish onboarding. Options we propose: 
- Primary: Redwood Portal (structured invoice fields, PO mapping).
- Interim fallback: nightly compressed batch (ZIP of PDFs) delivered to ap@sunbridgehealth.com until portal onboarding completes.

A couple of implementation details we need to confirm from your side:
1) Confirm the exact AP ingest address you want on the ZIP (ap@sunbridgehealth.com OK?).
2) Do you require the invoice to embed the PO number in the PDF body (visible line item) or is a metadata field/filename sufficient for your ERP? We can do both; sample attached.
3) Please send the VAT registration file if you want us to attach/retain it with invoices (we can add VAT_certificate_Sunbridge.pdf to future emails).

I am looping in Jordan (account) to keep him in the loop. Connor in Billing Ops will implement the daily push if we agree.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Sr. Partnerships Ops
Redwood Inference
(signed)

From: connor.obrien@redwood.com
To: sofia.ivanova@redwood.com, jordan.blake@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Oct 2028 02:22:00 -0700
Subject: internal: implementation notes for Sunbridge delivery

Sofia / Jordan — quick ops note so we can action.

We can: 
- Turn on portal as primary (that’s configuration work on our tenant mapping).
- Enable nightly ZIP of PDFs delivered to a configurable AP address. That is a batch job we run at 02:00 PT; it will include all invoices generated in the prior 24 hours.

Limitations / asks:
- We need a signed confirmation to keep sending ZIPs for >30 days (ops cost + retention). Recommend a 30-day fallback window while onboarding completes.
- To include PO on every invoice PDF, we'll: add the PO to the visible header line AND include it in the filename (invoice-8421-<invoiceid>.pdf). That meets the majority of AP upload requirements.
- We will attach any VAT certificate you provide to the emailed ZIP; otherwise we can reference your VAT number in the PDF.

If Jordan approves, I’ll schedule the nightly job and add ap@sunbridgehealth.com as the recipient. Also suggest we put a coarse SLA in the onboarding doc: portal up within 10 business days.

—Connor
Billing Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi Elena — confirming next steps so we’re aligned: 

1) Primary channel: Redwood Portal. We’ll create your vendor tenant and send portal invites to your AP users (please share the list of emails to invite).
2) Interim fallback: Starting tonight (10/10) we will deliver a nightly ZIP of PDFs containing any invoices generated that day to ap@sunbridgehealth.com. This will run for 30 days while you onboard; we can extend if needed with written approval.
3) PO handling: We will render the PO number on the invoice header and include it in the PDF filename (example attached: sample_invoice_with_PO.pdf).
4) VAT evidence: please send the VAT certificate (we received PO_8421.pdf only). We will attach VAT_certificate_Sunbridge.pdf to the ZIP if provided, and we will also print the VAT registration number on the invoice PDF.

Attachments included: portal_onboarding-checklist.pdf (steps & timeline), sample_invoice_with_PO.pdf (visual), PO_8421.pdf (you sent), VAT_certificate_Sunbridge.pdf (please upload if available).

Next action for Sunbridge: reply with the list of AP user emails for portal invites and confirm you accept a 30-day nightly-email fallback. Once we receive that, Connor will enable the nightly job and Jordan will send a short onboarding calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you on portal.

Best regards,
